Rules

Right-align numeric / monetary columns; left-align text columns.
Use font-mono for IDs, roll numbers, and amounts so digits align.
Row click is reserved for "view detail." Inline actions (edit, delete) require an explicit button.
Empty / loading / error states are required — see StudentFeed.jsx.
